card.name: First digit of numbers in dose data
card.fires_on: The first digit or decimal point of a number in clinical data, such as a percentage, dose or lab value. It also fires on a few linking words like "of" after "Elevations" and on opening parentheses before a dose.

modes.label: Digits in doses and rates
modes.description: The first digit of a number in a dose, percentage or lab value, often inside parentheses.

modes.label: Decimal point in lab values
modes.description: The decimal point inside a lab value such as hemoglobin.

modes.label: Linking words in lab or liver findings
modes.description: A small word or parenthesis right before a lab term or dose.

card.writes: It slightly favors body-part words such as brain, muscle, lung, stomach and vessel, with no clear link to numbers.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of a number in a dose or lab result, where the text is about to give a measurement.
